documentary_passages.text: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF THE CONGO: Admin Level 2 Boundaries

The dataset represents the territories of DR Congo. The file originates from OCHA's digitization of the DR Congo atlas of administrative boundaries carried out by Father Léon de Saint Moulin. The geometry has been split where territory boundaries are defined by a watercourse. A topological validation has been done by UNDP and the Kinshasa municipal boundaries have been added. Toponymy has been validated by INS.
Administrative Level 2 Boundaries of DR Congo. Validated by the IMWG. Sourced from Référentiel Géographique Commun http://www.rgc.cd

Layer was downloaded as a shapefile by ITOS from an email from the IMO. It was then analyzed by ITOS for errors. Those errors were corrected and then the layer was sent back to UNOCHA as a feature class within a file geodatabase.

The following errors were found and fixed by ITOS: 
1. Created and populated a reference name field.
2. Projection changed from undefined to "GCS_WGS_1984".
3. Admin0 name now uses French UN Short Name "République démocratique du Congo (la)".

ITOS changed projection from undefined to GCS_WGS_1984. This is a recorded metadata operation, not evidence of a geodetic survey or datum transformation.

Archive does not supply an adopted lake median coordinate line, lake-edge construction rule, atlas edition/year/page, or original digitization control points. Watercourse splitting does not establish that lake median edges were reconstructed.
